attempts.evidence: persistent -session -before block event ok=false; verify_process: verification failed; failed_goal: $unproved(1)
attempts.lesson: Declaring an abstract predicate interface does not prove any application; only an explicit trust statement may add that proposition.

accepted_blocks.source:
try:
    abstract_prop marked(x)

    trust forall y R:
        y = 1
        =>:
            $marked(y)
accepted_blocks.lesson: The verifier retains the abstract interface and explicit trusted proposition as distinct statement kinds.
